identity.title: Properties of Submillimeter Galaxies in the CANDELS GOODS-South Field

paper_type_evidence.quote: The submm data for the galaxies discussed in this paper are taken from the ALMA 870$\mu$m survey presented in Hodge et al. (2013).
The high angular resolution of the ALMA imaging allows secure counterparts to be identified in the CANDELS multiband dataset.

targets.name: LESS submillimeter galaxies in GOODS-S (10 counterparts)

distance_source.value: SED-fitting photometric redshifts; spectroscopic for 4 sources (Balestra 2010, Kriek 2008, Vanzella 2008)

question.value: What are the stellar, morphological, gas and dust properties of ALMA-identified LESS submillimeter galaxies in the CANDELS GOODS-S field?

evidence.quote: We derive physical properties of 10 submillimeter galaxies located in the CANDELS coverage of the GOODS-S field.
This paper makes use of the following ALMA data: ADS/JAO.ALMA#2011.0.00294.S.
The submm data for the galaxies discussed in this paper are taken from the ALMA 870$\mu$m survey presented in Hodge et al. (2013).
The median angular resolution of the interferometric data is 1$\,.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$60$\times$1$\,.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$15.
The noise level of the ALMA map is as good as any of the LESS sources in the ‘Primary sample’ with $\sim$0.55 mJy/beam.

provided.value: optical/NIR photometry and F160W images for counterparts, morphology

evidence.quote: CANDELS is a HST Multi-Cycle Treasury Program to image five legacy fields, including the GOODS-South, with the Wide Field Camera 3 (WFC3) in the near-infrared.

provided.value: mid-IR photometry; 24um used to constrain power-law

evidence.quote: The 24$\mu$m flux is not used in the SED fitting procedure, but is used in estimating the potential influence of a power-law continuum.

what.value: ALMA 870um fluxes and positions of LESS sources

evidence.quote: Submm continuum flux from Hodge et al. (2013).

what.value: CANDELS GOODS-S F160W-selected photometric catalog (18 bands)

evidence.quote: A catalog (Guo et al. 2013) was made based on source detection in the WFC3 F160W band.

what.value: Sample of local galaxies and z~2 LBGs for Gini-M20 comparison

evidence.quote: The comparison samples are the same as in Conselice (2003; see Table 1, 4 and 5) and Lotz et al. (2004).
The parametrization is valid for $S_{850}<15$ mJy and for $z\approx1-6$:

what.value: ALMA data reduction, flux and positions taken from the ALMA LESS survey

evidence.quote: For sources detected at more than 3$\sigma$, the positional uncertainty of the center of emission is estimated to be 0$\,.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$2–0$\,.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$3 (Hodge et al. 2013).

what.value: SED fitting algorithm is updated version of earlier code

evidence.quote: The current version of the SED fitting algorithm is an updated version of the one described in Wiklind et al (2008).

what.value: Photometry via PSF matching and TFIT

evidence.quote: Photometry of lower resolution images is done using the TFIT template-fitting method (see Laidler et al. 2007; Lee et al. 2012; Guo et al. 2013).

unstated_but_needed: ALMA calibration, CASA version and imaging parameters (reimaging of LESS 17 and 34 mentioned but not specified)
Exact aperture/photometry values per band for the SED fits
CAS measurement parameters (apertures, segmentation) for morphology

method.value: Match ALMA LESS positions to CANDELS F160W catalog; nearest galaxy within 1 arcsec is counterpart

evidence.quote: If the separation between the center of the ALMA 870$\mu$m emission and the nearest galaxy exceeds 1$\,.\!\!^{\prime\prime}$0, we do not consider the galaxy and the SMG to be associated

analysis_steps.goal: SED fitting for redshift, mass, age

method.value: BC03 templates with delayed-tau SFH, Chabrier IMF, Calzetti extinction, Madau IGM; chi2 minimisation; optional power-law subtraction scaled to 8um

evidence.quote: Dust obscuration is introduced using the attenuation law of Calzetti et al. (2000).
Four different metallicities are used, 0.2, 0.4, 1.0, and 2.5 Z$_{\odot}$.
The latter sample contains SMGs similar to the ones discussed here, and we will assume $\alpha=2.0$.

fitting.value: chi2 minimization with 10^3 Monte Carlo realisations of photometry; P(z) ∝ exp(-chi2)

evidence.quote: We generate $10^{3}$ photometric data sets for each galaxy.

validation.value: Tested with 11 other codes against spectroscopic redshifts (Dahlen et al. 2013)

evidence.quote: The photometric redshifts obtained in the SED fitting process with this code has been tested together with 11 other codes

method.value: CAS, Gini and M20 on F160W images, comparison with mass/z-matched control samples, visual classification

evidence.quote: We measure the CAS (concentration, asymmetry and clumpiness) parameters of the SMG counterparts using HST/WFC3 F160W images.

validation.value: Monte Carlo of randomized control galaxies, 10^3 times

evidence.quote: Repeating this procedure $10^{3}$ times, we find that in 99% of the Monte Carlo realizations

method.value: Optically thin dust mass from 870um flux; gas from dust-to-gas ratio and H2/HI; SFR from Hayward et al. 2013 relation; LFIR from SFR

evidence.quote: As shown by Scoville (2012) and Scoville et al. (2014), the observed submm flux is linearly dependent on the dust mass as long as the emission remains optically thin.
assuming a dust temperature of $T_{d}={\bf35}$ K, we derive the dust masses listed in Table [5]
The average H$_2$/HI ratio for this sample is $\sim$2 and we will assume that this is the case for our SMGs as well.

validation.value: Compared with CO-derived gas mass of LESS 73

evidence.quote: we estimate a molecular gas mass of $5.2\times10^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$ for LESS 73.

used_for.value: source extraction in CANDELS catalog (from Guo et al.)

evidence.quote: The sources were extracted using SExtractor in both a hot and cold mode.
Photometry of lower resolution images is done using the TFIT template-fitting method
The redshift range is z$=$1.65-4.76, with two of the galaxies located at z$>$4.
Disregarding LESS 10 and LESS 34, the average stellar mass is $M_{*} = (1.1 \pm 0.4) \times 10^{11}$ M$_{\odot}$
M$_{\mathrm{dust}}=(4.0\pm1.3)\times10^{8}$ M$_{\odot}$
the average H$_2$ mass is $M_{\mathrm{H_2}}=(5.1\pm1.7)\times10^{10}$ M$_{\odot}$
the average gas fraction for the remaining 8 SMGs is $0.28\pm0.07$ (sample standard deviation)
with an average of $(0.8\pm0.7)\times10^{3}$ M$_{\odot}$ yr$^{-1}$

findings_qualitative.value: 3 of 10 SMG counterparts are mergers, 2 have neighbours, 5 are isolated

evidence.quote: we find 3 SMGs that are part of mergers (LESS 13, 67 and 79.2), 2 SMGs with neighbors within 30 kpc (LESS 34 and 45), and 5 that appears to be completely isolated

claims.hypothesis: Are SMG counterparts mostly mergers and more asymmetric than comparable galaxies?
claims.experiment: CAS morphology vs mass/z-matched control samples and visual inspection of F160W images
claims.result: 3 mergers, 7 not; average asymmetry higher than controls in 99% of Monte Carlo realizations
claims.finding: SMGs are more asymmetric but mostly isolated, unlike local ULIRGs

evidence.quote: in 99% of the Monte Carlo realizations, the average asymmetry of the SMG counterparts is higher than the average $A$ value of the control galaxies.

claims.hypothesis: Do SMG counterparts have uniform stellar masses?
claims.result: Two have masses 2-3 orders lower; rest ~1e11 Msun
claims.finding: Two stellar mass groups; SMG stellar populations older than the SMG phase

evidence.quote: Two SMG counterparts have stellar masses 2-3 orders of magnitude lower than the rest.

why_this_data.value: Interferometric submm positions give less biased counterpart identification than radio or IRAC

evidence.quote: Submm interferometry represents the least biased method at our disposal to identify the counterparts of SMGs.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Low masses of LESS 10 and 34 not due to power-law subtraction or obscured stars; may be background source

evidence.quote: The low masses are not due to the subtraction of a power-law continuum.

limitations_admitted.value: Single-component SFH cannot model multiple bursts; ages and masses uncertain

evidence.quote: It is, however, not able to model a multiple-burst star formation history.

referee_caveats_inferred: Single 870um flux with assumed Td=35 K gives dust/gas masses uncertain by factor of a few
SFR from a simulation-calibrated relation, not measured
Counterpart association for offset sources (LESS 17) could be wrong

data_public_as_stated.value: ALMA data cited by project code in acknowledgments
